defs.def: a metal frame for cooking food on over an open fire outdoors （烧烤野餐用的）烤架

ex.s: The barbecue gives it that famous smoky flavour and it comes with a shiny sauce that's very, very spicy!
ex.t: 烧烤赋予了它那著名的烟熏风味，再配上一种色泽发亮、非常非常辣的酱汁！

ex.s: Since I arrived, my friend has brought me to my first open-air barbecue and has also shared many different but yummy meals with me, so my first impressions of Australia have been all about food!
ex.t: 自从我来到这里，朋友就带我参加了我的第一次户外烧烤，还和我分享了许多不同却美味的食物，所以我对澳大利亚的第一印象全是关于美食的！

ex.s: Perhaps the favourite way of cooking food in Australia is the barbecue, or “barbie”.
ex.t: 也许在澳大利亚最受欢迎的烹饪方式就是烧烤（barbecue），或称“barbie”。

ex.s: Often these barbecues feature a “mixed grill”, which means cooking all kinds of meat, seafood, and vegetables.
ex.t: 这些烧烤常常以“混合烧烤”为特色，也就是把各种肉类、海鲜和蔬菜一起烤。

ex.s: So, at an Australian barbecue, you don’t have to eat kangaroo—or even eat meat at all—if you don’t want to.
ex.t: 所以，在澳大利亚的烧烤聚会上，如果你不想吃，就不必吃袋鼠肉——甚至根本不必吃肉。

defs.def: an outdoor meal or party when food is cooked in this way 烧烤野餐
